name: United Suvadive Republic (1959–1963)
description: Three horizontal stripes of light blue, green and red, with a white crescent and star on the green stripe, a white star in the upper fly and another in the lower hoist.
history: The southern atolls of the Maldives — Addu, Huvadhu and Fuvahmulah — seceded on 3 January 1959 under Abdullah Afeef with British sympathy; the flag, sewn from bunting supplied by the British at Gan, was raised on 13 March 1959. The republic was dissolved under Maldivian pressure and the flag lowered at Maradhoo on 23 September 1963.

features.role: one star by the crescent, one in the upper fly, one in the lower hoist
features.symbolism: the three atolls of the republic
